'''Follow the White Rabbit Bikers of a forest planet''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Follow the White Rabbit]]
* '''Published:''' 3 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)|Endor-D-endorlandingplatformdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Endor Landing Platform (Docking Ba.txt |Download]]

Biker Scout Deck.

== Strategy ==

Yea, this deck sounds resonable as an Endor Deck, then again i wouldn't know. IM A NEWBIE OK, and i dont want to copy other people's decks... so i make my own, this is probably crappy, but then again, so is my ewok one, so they should be a fair match.
